title: Vehicle Service Contracts Cancellation Terms by Plan
content:
For Vehicle Service Contracts, the events that cancel a contract, the signed-request terms for a borrower's own cancellation and the date and odometer at which each kind of cancellation takes effect are identical across the six DriveSure plans.

## Schedule 1: cancelling events and signed requests

| Term | Powertrain | Powertrain Plus | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Exclusionary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paying the retail installment contract off cancels the service contract | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| The company, as lienholder, cancels the service contract when the repossessed vehicle is sold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The service contract is cancelled when the vehicle is declared a total loss | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A borrower's voluntary cancellation needs a signed cancellation request | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Calendar days a cancellation request sent for signature stays open | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| An unwound contract's service contract is voided with a full refund | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Schedule 2: effective date and odometer by reason (every plan)

| Cancellation reason | Effective date and odometer |
|---|---|
| Borrower voluntary | the date and odometer on the signed request |
| Repossession sale | the vehicle sale date and the odometer at recovery |
| Total loss | the date of loss and the odometer on the insurer valuation |
| Contract unwound | the retail installment contract's closed date and the odometer at sale |

**Odometer used to measure mileage consumed (every plan):** the odometer reading on the record of the triggering event.

## Reading Schedule 2 (hypothetical records)

- A service contract cancelled because the repossessed vehicle was sold takes the sale date as its effective date and the odometer recorded at recovery as its cancellation odometer, even where the sale took place weeks after the recovery.
- A cancellation on a total loss takes the date of loss and the odometer on the insurer valuation, not the date the cancellation is processed.
